blocks.text:
(PT) Private Transfers + Domestic Flight + Mérida City Tour Duration: Flight ~1.5 hrs + City Tour 2.5–3 Hours (Times available 13:00, 16:00, and 18:00 Hrs) • Language: English and Spanish 
Today, you'll say goodbye to the mountains of Oaxaca and head to Mérida, the elegant capital of Yucatán known as La Ciudad Blanca (The White City). A private transfer will take you to the Oaxaca airport, where you’ll board a short domestic flight to Mérida. Upon arrival, another private transfer will be waiting to take you to your hotel. Once checked in, take a moment to refresh before stepping out to explore the city. In the afternoon, join us for a guided walking tour through the main streets of Mérida’s Centro Histórico. Discover the majestic Cathedral of San Ildefonso, one of the oldest in the Americas, and stroll past colonial-era buildings and the vibrant Zócalo, where history and everyday life blend beautifully. Available tour times: 13:00, 16:00, or 18:00 hrs. To complete the day, we’ll gladly recommend some of our favorite local spots where you can enjoy a delicious Yucatecan meal. Be sure to try regional specialties like cochinita pibil, sopa de lima, or papadzules—flavors that make this region truly unforgettable. 
Tour Highlights: 
● Seamless private transfers in Oaxaca and Mérida 
● Comfortable flight between two of Mexico’s cultural capitals 
● Discover Mérida’s colonial and Mayan heritage with a tour guide 
● Personalized dining recommendations for authentic Yucatecan cuisine 
Included: Private Transfers (Hotel–Oaxaca Airport / Mérida Airport–Hotel), City Tour with Bilingual Guide, Overnight in Mérida 
Not Included: Flight not included, Meals, Tips, and Personal Expenses.
